exposure: labor status prior to cesarean delivery
outcome: postpartum opioid consumption (in oral milligram morphine equivalents)
cohort: Postpartum individuals aged 18 years or older who underwent cesarean delivery for a singleton pregnancy.
finding: Adverse childhood experiences were associated with increased opioid use specifically in individuals who underwent unlabored cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Adverse childhood experiences were associated with increased opioid use in unlabored cesarean delivery only, but not in labored cesarean delivery.
